transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. It's very nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um... I'm here because, well, I want to make sure I'm explaining this right, so please just stop me if I'm not making sense or giving you the right information. I've been noticing some things lately, and I'm honestly a little embarrassed to even bring it up. I don't want you to think poorly of me. 

It's probably just an overactive imagination, or maybe just the strange acoustics in my building, but... I keep hearing these very clear voices in my apartment. And sometimes when I'm out, too, like in the empty rooms at the museum. It sounds exactly like women whispering from right behind the walls. They... they tell me which photographs belong in the archive. 

I know that probably sounds terribly silly to say out loud, and I really hope you don't think I'm completely losing my mind. Is... is that the sort of thing you were asking for?
Have you used any drugs or substances around the times when you hear these voices?

Oh, goodness, no. I... I promise you, I don't touch anything like that. I really hope you didn't get the impression that I'm... well, that sort of person. 

I know people probably assume the worst when someone admits to hearing things, and it makes perfect sense why you would ask, but I've never used any drugs in my entire life. I barely even drink tea anymore because of the caffeine. I just wanted to be completely honest with you about the whispering, but I would never do anything illegal or put strange substances in my body. 

Does... does that answer what you needed to know? I just want to make sure I'm being helpful and giving you the right picture.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, energetic, or euphoric for days at a time?

Well... yes, I suppose there are times like that. I hope it doesn't sound terribly arrogant, but I do get these days where I just feel... well, radiant. Like I've been chosen for something very special. It's actually quite a lovely feeling, being so full of energy and purpose. 

But... oh dear, I want to be perfectly honest with you, even though it's a bit shameful for me to admit. I really don't want you to think I'm a difficult or mean person. But when I feel that way, if someone questions my plans or tells me I need to slow down... I can become just furious. It feels almost as if they are trying to erase me entirely. 

I always feel so dreadful about it because I try so hard to be gentle and agreeable with people. Is... is that what you meant by unusually high? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right and giving you what you need to know.
When you have those radiant, highly energized periods, do they last at least one full week?

Oh, well... a week? Yes, I suppose so. Honestly, if I look back over the past year, those times... well, they sort of string together. 

I'm so sorry to admit this, I know it sounds terribly excessive, but if I add it all up, those bursts where I barely need any sleep at all, and my mind is just racing with all these grand plans, and... and I spend a bit too much money... it's probably taken up about six months in total. 

I really hope you don't think I'm completely out of control. I try very hard to keep things tidy and manageable, but the energy just takes over for long stretches. Does... does that make sense? I hope I'm not giving you too much unnecessary detail.
Do you ever hear the whispering voices during times when your mood feels normal—not especially high or energized?

Well... yes. I... I really hope you don't think I'm making this up or just being difficult. But even when I'm not feeling all that energy, when I'm just... normal, I suppose... the voices are still there. 

There was a time just a little while ago, maybe for a few weeks, where I felt perfectly fine. Not grand or racing around at all. But... well, I still heard the whispering in my apartment. And I was still absolutely certain that the people from the arts council were monitoring my phone calls. 

I'm so sorry, I know that must sound completely irrational to you. I try so hard to just ignore it and be sensible, but it just doesn't stop, even when my mood is perfectly steady. I hope that's the kind of information you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions properly.
Have you had any recent neurological illness or head injury?

Oh... no. No, nothing like that at all. I haven't bumped my head or had any kind of... well, any physical brain illnesses or anything of that sort. 

I try very hard to be careful and take good care of my physical health, you know, so I'm not a burden to anyone. I've always been quite cautious about that. Is... is it helpful that I haven't had anything like that happen? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers for your notes.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?

Oh... no, I don't think so. I mean, everyone has a gloomy afternoon here and there, I suppose, but... no, never for two whole weeks. 

I really try my very best to keep a positive outlook and just keep moving forward. I wouldn't want to be a bother to anyone by moping around or letting things get me down like that. I always try to put on a brave face, for everyone's sake. I hope that's a good thing? I just want to make sure I'm doing my part to stay as cheerful as I can. Is that the kind of answer you were looking for?
For at least six months, have the voices or the belief that people were monitoring you been present most of the time?

Oh... well... I really hate to admit this, because I know it must sound so silly of me to let it go on without fixing it. But... yes. It's been... I'd say about eight months now. The whispering, and that... that certainty I have that people are watching my archive. It's been present for about eight months. 

I've tried so very hard to just push it out of my mind and not make a fuss, but it just lingers most of the time. I hope it's alright that I'm telling you this... I just didn't want you to think I was completely losing my wits or being a difficult patient by letting it go on for so long. Did I answer that clearly enough for your records? I can try to be more precise if you need me to be.
Have the voices or suspicious beliefs ever continued for at least two weeks when your mood was completely normal?

Oh... well... yes. I hope it doesn't make me sound too terribly difficult, but yes, that has happened. There was a period of several weeks where my mood was actually quite steady. I wasn't feeling especially energized or... or grand, like I sometimes get. I was just trying my best to be calm and pleasant, you know? 

But... I'm a bit embarrassed to say, the whispers in the apartment were still there. And I still just... I remained convinced that the arts people were monitoring my phone. I really tried to just ignore it all so I wouldn't be a bother to anyone, but it didn't go away even when my mood was perfectly fine. I hope I'm explaining that right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need for your notes.
